dialogues.speaker: "Tricky Bulle Fruit"
dialogues.text: Huh? Benefactor! How did you get in? Oh, forget it. I forgot how masterful you are. You definitely have your ways.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And how did you get in this time?

dialogues.speaker: "Tricky Bulle Fruit"
dialogues.text: Haha, good question! Don't forget, I don't have this name for nothing! I've got my ways too.

dialogues.speaker: "Tricky Bulle Fruit"
dialogues.text: Shh... Keep quiet. I'm still figuring this place out.

dialogues.speaker: "Tricky Bulle Fruit"
dialogues.text: Seems like most people here only go to the Rag and Bone Shop to buy their bric a brac. I can't go prancing about with my wares setting up shop willy-nilly... Wouldn't be good to attract the wrong kind of attention from certain parties...

dialogues.speaker: "Tricky Bulle Fruit"
dialogues.text: She's good. I found her a tutor before coming in. Heehee, can you guess what kind of tutor? Photography!

dialogues.speaker: "Tricky Bulle Fruit"
dialogues.text: I've told the tutor to fill her world with pictures every day, all of beautiful scenery from exotic locales abroad. This way, she's bound to want to visit them someday.

dialogues.speaker: "Tricky Bulle Fruit"
dialogues.text: And in the future, she won't be so against the idea of going overseas to study.

dialogues.speaker: "Tricky Bulle Fruit"
dialogues.text: Oh, I used to have a buddy with red hair. Maybe I haven't been getting enough sleep recently, because I keep seeing him around down here in the prison. My eyes must be playing tricks on me.

dialogues.speaker: "Tricky Bulle Fruit"
dialogues.text: You can't forget where you came from and, of course, what others did for you. Please take this, as a token of my appreciation.
